items.description: A bustling border town located along the Caledon River facing South Africa. It serves as a significant commercial hub in the northern region of Lesotho.
Known as the historical center of the Lesotho Evangelical Church, Morija is a culturally significant town. It hosts the annual Morija Arts and Cultural Festival.
Famous for being the gateway to the Maletsunyane Falls, one of the highest single-drop waterfalls in Africa. It is a popular destination for adventure tourism.
A small settlement situated near the Caledon River in the Berea District. It maintains a quiet, rural character typical of Lesotho's countryside.
A remote and peaceful village setting in the Mafeteng District. It reflects the traditional rural lifestyle of the Lesotho plateau.
A community located in the mountainous Qacha's Nek District. It provides essential services to the surrounding rural population.
A settlement notable for its proximity to the Katse Dam construction area. It has grown due to major water infrastructure projects.
Home to the impressive Katse Dam, the largest reservoir in Lesotho. The area serves as a key site for water engineering and power generation.
A small rural village known for its missionary history and educational presence. It is situated in the central highlands.
A village settlement in the Leribe District, focusing on traditional agriculture and local trade. It is nestled in the foothills.
A historically significant site in the Mohale's Hoek District, known for its early missionary activity. It serves as a local agricultural community.
A rural community settlement in the southern part of Lesotho. It is characterized by its rugged terrain and small-scale farming.
